sloka: सम्श्रुत्य च पितुर् वाक्यम् मातुर् वा ब्राह्मणस्य वा ।न कर्तव्यम् वृथा वीर धर्मम् आश्रित्य तिष्ठता ॥२-२१-४१॥
transliteration: samśrutya ca pitur vākyam mātur vā brāhmaṇasya vā ।na kartavyam vṛthā vīra dharmam āśritya tiṣṭhatā ॥2-21-41॥

translations.english: Any one, O hero, who has taken recourse to righteousness should not allow the promise made to his father, mother or a brahmin to go in vain.
